business_problem: Founded in 2022 in Germany, nnamu built a proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) for strategic reasoning based on game theory. The company’s first AI agent is live and can autonomously define negotiation strategies and negotiate with suppliers on behalf of procurement organizations.
solution_summary: Founded in 2022 in Germany, nnamu built a proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) for strategic reasoning based on game theory. The company’s first AI agent is live and can autonomously define negotiation strategies and negotiate with suppliers on behalf of procurement organizations. To streamline the modernization project, nnamu implemented Amazon Q into every stage of the development lifecycle. The startup provided each team member with a subscription to Amazon Q Developer, a generative AI–powered assistant for software development that generates code suggestions in near real time. Using this tool, developers can quickly identify areas to optimize code, improving quality and consistency. Product owners create detailed prompts describing the requirements and functionalities of new features, systems, or products.
